bugLogs.title: Insufficient color contrast for error message text
affected_users: older adults with declining contrast sensitivity
steps_to_reproduce: Trigger a card number validation error
Observe the error message displayed in the element with id "card-error"
bugLogs.expected_behavior: Error message text must have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against the background (or 3:1 if considered large text).
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The text color #ff9999 on a white background #ffffff yields a contrast ratio of 2.04:1, which is below the required threshold.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: In the CSS rule for #card-error, change color from #ff9999 to #a36262 (4.69:1 on #ffffff; measured 2.04:1, required 4.5:1).

bugLogs.title: Select element #state missing accessible name
steps_to_reproduce: Navigate to the state selection dropdown
Observe that no label is announced by screen readers
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The select element must have an accessible name via an associated <label>, aria-label, aria-labelledby, title attribute, or role="none"/"presentation" if appropriate.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The <select id="state"> element has no associated label, no aria-label, no aria-labelledby, and no title attribute, resulting in no accessible name.
bugLogs.suggested_fix:
Add a visible label element linked with for="state" or add an aria-label attribute. Example:
<label for="state">State</label>
<select id="state" aria-label="State">
  ...
</select>
